name: Daily Sales Summary
query:
SELECT
  se.dated AS `Date`,
  se.department AS `Department`,
  se.sale_type AS `Sale Type`,
  SUM(se.amount) AS `Amount`
FROM `tabSales Entry` se
WHERE se.docstatus = 1
  AND (%(dated)s IS NULL OR %(dated)s = '' OR se.dated = %(dated)s)
  AND (%(department)s IS NULL OR %(department)s = '' OR se.department = %(department)s)
  AND (%(sale_type)s IS NULL OR %(sale_type)s = '' OR se.sale_type = %(sale_type)s)
GROUP BY se.dated, se.department, se.sale_type
ORDER BY se.dated DESC
